title.zh: 加密PAC斥资1100万美元在俄亥俄州反对谢罗德·布朗
title.en: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio

current_state.zh: Defend American Jobs及其关联的Digital Freedom Fund已在俄亥俄州参议院竞选中投入超过5000万美元，主要支持共和党人Jon Husted并反对民主党人Sherrod Brown，且10月仍在继续支出。
current_state.en: Defend American Jobs and its affiliated Digital Freedom Fund have now spent more than $50 million in the Ohio Senate race, mostly backing Republican Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown, with spending continuing into October.

updates.title_zh: 加密PAC斥资1100万美元在俄亥俄州反对谢罗德·布朗
updates.title_en: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
updates.what_changed_zh: 与Fairshake有关联、立场亲加密的Defend American Jobs PAC报告称，在俄亥俄州美国参议院竞选中花费1140万美元投放广告，支持共和党人乔恩·赫斯特德并反对民主党人谢罗德·布朗，这是该州3000万美元初始承诺的一部分。
updates.what_changed_en: The crypto-aligned Defend American Jobs PAC, affiliated with Fairshake, reported spending $11.4 million on ads backing Republican Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown in Ohio's US Senate race, part of an initial $30 million pledge in the state.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: The crypto-aligned Defend American Jobs PAC, affiliated with Fairshake, reported spending $11.4 million on ads backing Republican Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown in Ohio's US Senate race, part of an initial $30 million pledge in the state.

updates.title_zh: 加密PAC在俄亥俄州参议院竞选中大举支出
updates.title_en: Crypto PACs spend big on Ohio Senate race
updates.what_changed_zh: Defend American Jobs在俄亥俄州参议院竞选中9月支出约2400万美元，使其本轮总支出超过4600万美元，并在10月继续支出；Digital Freedom Fund另支出590万美元支持Husted、反对Brown。
updates.what_changed_en: Defend American Jobs spent about $24 million in the Ohio Senate race in September, bringing its cycle total above $46 million and continuing spending in October; the Digital Freedom Fund added $5.9 million supporting Husted and opposing Brown.
updates.current_state_zh: Defend American Jobs及其关联的Digital Freedom Fund已在俄亥俄州参议院竞选中投入超过5000万美元，主要支持共和党人Jon Husted并反对民主党人Sherrod Brown，且10月仍在继续支出。
updates.current_state_en: Defend American Jobs and its affiliated Digital Freedom Fund have now spent more than $50 million in the Ohio Senate race, mostly backing Republican Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown, with spending continuing into October.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Crypto-affiliated PAC Defend American Jobs spent about $24 million in the Ohio Senate race in September, mostly supporting Republican incumbent Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown, bringing its total spending above $46 million.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Crypto-affiliated PAC Defend American Jobs spent about $24 million in the Ohio Senate race in September, mostly supporting Republican incumbent Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown, bringing its total spending above $46 million.
